def sw_state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    s = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==3 and n['boundary'][0][0]==42:
            s[n['boundary'][0][1]] = n['color']
    return [s.get(c,'?') for c in [20,25,30,35,40]]
def ball_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']==14:
            return n['boundary'][0]
    return None
cols=[21,26,31,36,41]
tried=set(['10100','00100','00000','01000','01010','01011','11011','11111','01111','00111','00011','00001','10000','10101'])
allp=[f"{a}{b}{c}{d}{e}" for a in '01' for b in '01' for c in '01' for d in '01' for e in '01']
rem=[p for p in allp if p not in tried]
cur=''.join('1' if x=='B' else '0' for x in sw_state())
rem.sort(key=lambda p: bin(int(cur,2)^int(p,2)).count('1'))
print("current:",cur,"order:",rem)
def set_pattern(p):
    cur=''.join('1' if x=='B' else '0' for x in sw_state())
    for i in range(5):
        if cur[i]!=p[i]:
            action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':cols[i]}])
            cur=''.join('1' if x=='B' else '0' for x in sw_state())
for p in rem[:6]:
    set_pattern(p)
    st=''.join('1' if x=='B' else '0' for x in sw_state())
    bp=ball_pos()
    done=last_action_result.get('done'); lc=last_action_result.get('level_completed')
    print("set",p,"->",st,"ball",bp,"done",done,"lc",lc)
    if done or lc or bp!=(13,30):
        print("CHANGED at",p); break
